title: Built an AI Quantitative Trade Copilot + Seasonality Engine (Entry, SL, TP, Win-Rate Matrix, Volume Profile)
author: Sad_Kitchen1567
selftext:
Hey everyone!

https://preview.redd.it/n8oj0o0s53oh1.png?width=1841&format=png&auto=webp&s=5d35e3eda8d84517cb9c84d4b349ee4ff0e7a032

I wanted to share a project I’ve been developing combining quantitative market regime modeling, **Volume Profile analysis, historical seasonality algorithms, and an AI Trade Plan Copilot.**

Most AI trading tools give generic text responses without actionable risk management parameters. I wanted to build an AI assistant that analyzes market structure (POC, Anchored VWAP, historical monthly seasonality, momentum, macro sentiment) and outputs precise, structured trade plans.

\### Core Features & Architecture:

\- **\*\*AI Trade Plan Generator\*\*** Given any ticker, the AI evaluates price action against key Volume Profile levels and outputs structured Entry Zones, Target Prices, Stop Losses, Risk/Reward Ratios, and setup confidence scores.

\- **\*\*Historical Seasonality Explorer & Ranking Matrix:\*\*** Quantifies 10+ year historical returns by month across asset classes (Win Rate % vs Avg Return %), providing scatter plots and monthly ranking benchmarks to filter seasonal outliers.

\- **\*\*S&P 500 Quantitative Momentum Strategy:\*\*** Backtested momentum ranking model tracking constituent stocks with equity curve metrics, monthly returns heat matrices, and Sharpe/Drawdown statistics.

\- **\*\*Real-Time Market Regime & Sentiment Engine:\*\*** Tracks VIX/VVIX ratios, smart money sentiment, and macro news briefings to contextualize AI setup filtering.

\- **\*\*Dedicated Ticker Directory & Analysis:\*\*** Single ticker deep-dive pages with real-time indicators and profiles.

Check out the live dashboard here: \*\*https://pocscanner.com\*\*

Would love to get feedback from fellow quants and traders on the prompt engineering, seasonality algorithms, or risk parameters you'd like to see included!
